notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue where loading the autosave in the sewers would take you to the wrong location, preventing you from progressing.
-Fixed an issue where you could climb the pipes and leave the map boundaries, causing you to fall infinitely.
-Fixed collisions with some objects that allowed you to access inaccessible areas or blocked the correct path.
-Other tweaks and bug fixes.
